version_caveat: GAF and OBO headers differ by one week; OBO supplies names only. Primary membership uses direct GAF terms without ancestor propagation.
term_size_rule: 10 to 3000 genes in annotated T1-expressed background
primary_test: one-sided hypergeometric enrichment, BH-FDR across all eligible direct BP terms
matched_sensitivity: top at most 60 terms with full-family q<0.10 and at least 3 panel hits; 1000 unique-gene random panels matched on T1 detection/mean deciles; empirical p is sensitivity only
limits: GO annotation coverage differs by gene; primary test conditions on GO-annotated expressed genes
strict current-symbol matching; no synonym rescue
all non-ND evidence codes including IEA; GO membership does not prove pathway activity or panel selection motive
direct annotations only may miss broad ancestor terms
matched sensitivity is post-selection and not separately family-wise corrected
